```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)

march_pitching <- read_csv("pitchingdata/may_2026_pitches.csv")
april_pitching <- read_csv("pitchingdata/april_2026_pitches.csv")
may_pitching <- read_csv("pitchingdata/may_2026_pitches.csv")
june_pitching <- read_csv("pitchingdata/june_2026_pitches.csv")
july_pitching <- read_csv("pitchingdata/july_2026_pitches.csv")
august_pitching <- read_csv("pitchingdata/august_2026_pitches.csv")
september_pitching <- read_csv("pitchingdata/september_2026_pitches.csv")

total_pitching <- rbind(
  march_pitching, april_pitching, may_pitching, 
  june_pitching, july_pitching, august_pitching, september_pitching
)

season_total <- total_pitching |> 
  filter(release_speed > 70)
```

# Plots

## Row 1

```{r}

velo_range <- ggplot(season_total, aes(description, release_speed)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplotly(velo_range)
```

```{r}

heat_zone <- ggplot(season_total, aes(x = plate_x, y = plate_z)) +
  stat_density_2d(
    aes(fill = after_stat(nlevel)),
    geom = "polygon",
    contour = TRUE,
    bins = 15
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Density") +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -0.83, xmax = 0.83,
    ymin = 1.5, ymax = 3.5,
    fill = NA,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-2.5, 2.5), ylim = c(0, 5))

ggplotly(heat_zone)
```
